title: Custom widget
description: Two ways to add a widget: in Astro when it needs new markup, in JSON when it arranges widgets that exist.

props.title: Bring your own widgets
props.subtitle: The Callout below is defined in this project (src/widgets/Callout.astro) and registered via config. The product shot after it is a JSON widget (src/content/widgets/ProductShot.json): no code, just widgets that exist, arranged once, with props of its own. Content references both by name, exactly like a built-in widget.

props.title: This is a project widget
props.text: It consumes a Parche primitive (Icon) and the design-system tokens, so it themes and styles consistently with everything else.

props.title: A widget written as content
props.text: Its props are declared in JSON Schema and checked on every use; its tree is the widgets it arranges.
